verdict.rationale: PayPal's agent toolkit and MCP server run on standard OAuth 2 access tokens, and the live MCP endpoint requires Bearer auth with a documented OAuth resource-metadata flow exposing limited scopes (openid/email/profile), which is some evidence of token-based, non-full-account credentials for agents. However, there's no documentation of merchant-configurable, fine-grained/least-privilege scopes (e.g., read-only vs. specific-resource permissions) tailored to agent use cases — the scopes shown are generic identity scopes, not commerce-action scoping. missing for 10: documented ability to mint custom least-privilege scopes/permission sets per agent, granular API-permission configuration UI or docs, and independent confirmation that agents are restricted to minimal necessary operations rather than full account-level OAuth access.
